thread:
mike: Postmortem posted for the authz incident. Root cause summary: an edge token-validation path combined with a permissions-map rollback that left stale entries. Audit exporter missed ~4m during the rollback. Full doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2777-authz-edge
infra-bot: Incident logged: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2777777777 status=postmortem, sev=P2
mike: Follow-ups I want tracked: (1) token validation harness + CI gating, (2) perm-map deploy guard + invariant tests, (3) audit-sink reliability + missing-event alerts/backfill, (4) secrets TTL/rotation verification + PD alert. Call owners and ETAs below.
anya: I'll own (1) token harness. Plan: unit + integration + GH Action. ETA 6 business days. Will include expired-token, rotated-token, and KV-cache replay scenarios.
rajesh: I'll take (3) audit-sink. Actions: add producer heartbeat, sink sequence checks, alert if gap >90s, and a short backfill playbook. ETA 5 business days. Need retention window from infra.
sec-bot: Noted recurring pattern: audit gaps and TTL drift seen in multiple incidents this year. Recommend a weekly telemetry query and monthly regression digest.
mike: I'll take (2) perm-map guard. Idea: pre-deploy diff validator that blocks privilege escalations for admin roles. ETA 7 business days.
rajesh: For backfill, if retention expired we'll coordinate with backups. Ping infra for S3 snapshots.
anya: CI vs nightly: do smoke checks in PRs and a nightly heavy replay. CLI example: `./tools/authz-harness --smoke` and `./tools/authz-harness --nightly --seed=sha1`.
sec-bot: Suggest adding a Prom metric `secrets_ttl_drift_total` and a PD rule if >1% of secrets drift beyond TTL in 24h.
mike: I'll own (4) secrets TTL check? actually assign to ops team. Rajesh, can you coordinate with ops for the TTL scanner?
rajesh: Will coordinate with ops. Ops to create CronJob scanner and expose `secrets_ttl_drift_total`.
anya: I'll open PR today and link it here. PR will add GH Action `authz-harness.yml` and `tools/authz-harness` scripts.
infra-bot: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/trackers/AUTHZ-2777. Tasks assigned and owners set.
mike: Scheduling a 30m follow-up in two weeks to verify fixes and monitor for regressions. I'll create the invite. Also please link PRs and tracker items to this thread so we can close the loop.
anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/platform/pull/11011 includes harness + CI gating
rajesh: Heartbeat emitter added to staging producers and a sequence-checker in sink. Backfill doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit/backfill-2777.md
sec-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled by mike for 2025-03-12 13:00 UTC. Reminder will post 48h before.
mike: Thanks everyone. Update this thread when PRs merged, monitors live, and alerts are created. We'll close items after 72h of healthy metrics in prod.
